anchors.0: Absent, wholly wrong, or no visible evidence of the required result; no credit.
anchors.1: Weak resemblance/fulfilment (about one quarter); major omissions or pervasive defects.
anchors.2: Partial (about half); recognizable intent but material errors in key requirements or visual quality.
anchors.3: Mostly correct (about three quarters); concrete remaining discrepancies prevent excellent credit.
anchors.4: Excellent: all important visible requirements satisfied, coherent and polished, no material discrepancy. Requires explicit positive evidence, not merely lack of reported faults.

checks.question: 场景是否呈现图书馆书架区域？
units: Library: high-shelf book retrieval.

units: seen obliquely from a low angle

units: A one-sided steel shelf

units: extracts the book 40 +/-5 mm beyond the shelf front while preserving its upright orientation within 2 degrees of neighbouring books

checks.question: 前置接收托盘是否开口向上且位于目标书中心下方？

checks.question: 净通路是否排除被评机器人并计入其他家具和凸出物？

checks.question: 升降范围及固定向上工具偏移是否能几何覆盖顶部取书与底部还书服务位置？
units: Use a 0.15-2.05 m lift stroke and a fixed 0.15 m upward tool-reference offset to reach both the 2.20 m top target and 0.30 m bottom return position.

checks.question: 书架是否设有暖色照明？

checks.question: 书脊是否呈米色？

checks.question: 机器人是否呈深灰色？
units: dark-grey robot

checks.question: 构图是否同时展示升降柱、部分抽出的书和空位？
units: Frame the lift column, partially extracted book and empty position.

checks.question: 机器人是否保持静态关节姿态，且无翻页或升降动画？
units:
Static; no page turning or lift animation.

Use metres and Z up. Build editable, solid three-dimensional geometry with separable semantic components, meaningful thickness and plausible support. A static articulated robot pose is required

checks.question: 冻结接触是否与其他服务目标区分，服务点是否有标注且未放置重复机器人？
units: Keep specified frozen contacts distinct from other service targets; label service points in the scene/README without placing duplicate robots.

checks.question: 第二透视视图是否展示关键接触和净空路线，并与主视图保持相同几何及冻结姿态？
units: Render alternate.png from a second perspective camera chosen to expose the critical contacts and clearance routes; follow any suggested alternate view when useful. Both views must show the same geometry and frozen pose
